name: Bug Fix
description: Workflow for triaging, fixing, testing, and deploying bug fixes.

steps.task: Triage the bug report. Determine severity, affected components, and assign to the appropriate developer (Frontend or Backend).
If the bug is frontend-related: reproduce the issue, identify root cause, implement the fix, and write a regression test.
If the bug is backend-related: reproduce the issue, identify root cause, implement the fix, and write a regression test.
Verify the fix resolves the original issue. Run regression tests to confirm no new issues. Test edge cases around the fixed area.
Deploy the hotfix to production. Monitor for errors post-deployment.
